own_solution.law: Hydrostatic equilibrium gives Δp = ρgh. Formally, (-1000.0)(9.8)(2.0) = -19600 Pa.
assumptions: The fluid is stationary and has uniform density.
Uniform terrestrial gravitational acceleration g = 9.8 m/s² is assumed.
The calculation treats the supplied negative density algebraically; it is not a physically admissible density for an ordinary fluid.

defect_reasons.invalid_parameter_domain: The specified mass density of -1000.0 kg/m³ is outside the physical domain of ordinary fluids, so the formal hydrostatic calculation does not describe an admissible fluid.

notes: All four renderings give the same formal pressure contribution, approximately -2.0 × 10^4 Pa at the supplied precision. Tank B's depth is structurally disconnected (D) in every rendering. The different depths occur in separate variants and create no internal contradiction. No numerical value of g is supplied; the numerical calculation uses the conventional terrestrial approximation.
